name: MoniKoopa
source: This is who King Koopa became after fusing with Monika. [spoiler]They realized they were inside a Doki Doki Literature Club mod and impersonated Monika until they finally trapped Mario by manipulating the game's code so they could finally kill Mario with an unlimited Koopa Troopa army.[/spoiler]
translation: This is who King Koopa became after fusing with Monika. [spoiler]They realized they were inside a Doki Doki Literature Club mod and impersonated Monika until they finally trapped Mario by manipulating the game's code so they could finally kill Mario with an unlimited Koopa Troopa army.[/spoiler]
